note: Measurement tool cost jobs (PLAN.md Measurement cost rule 2026-10-24, docs/168 §9): one cost job set per light tool without a measured cost, cheapest tool first so the queue can stop at any tool boundary (--from bp-tc-<tool>-off-1 or bp-tc-<tool>-ab resumes). Same save (Baseline-BP-Spring), seed 12345, release build asi.rel015 with the release ini; base = lean profiler (stages:false), no stack samplers; only the tool differs between the arms. Runtime-switchable tools (OwnJobWait = --ab ownjobwait, RouteEarlyOut observe = --ab earlyout): one in-load ABBA job each, 13.5 min, 1.5-min slices, 4 kept slices per arm (timing verdict valid alone). Start-time-only tools (HitchAttr, LogFallback, Holders, PlanRepeat, RouteJobPhases + SyncPlans, UnseenProbe, frames, mainstack, prof-tasks, prof-stages): one off/on two-load pair (off-1, on-1), each run valid-single, the pair a cross-run comparison (weaker evidence, labelled); a later opposite-order pair (on-2, off-2, same ids, asi and ini) pools to ABBA in hitch-ab.ts. Read per tool: node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts tool-cost-<date>-bp-tc-<tool> (it/s per run or arm); cost ms/s = 1000 x (1 - on it/s / off it/s); write it into docs/data/tool-costs.json msPerS and the docs/168 §9 table. Timing: clean night only (noise check on). 22 jobs: 20 pair jobs ~12 min + 2 in-load jobs ~16 min = ~4.5 h.
